title: cacalia mollissima
intro: Cacalia mollissima, commonly known as Chinese caterpillar fungus, is a type of fungus that grows on certain caterpillar species. It is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve immune function. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia mollissima include stimulating the immune system, reducing fatigue, and improving respiratory function, making it a sought-after remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Cacalia mollissima include cordycepin, cordycepic acid, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
